scope: Read-only analysis of completed VM evidence; no new execution. Cross-boot descriptive comparison only.
limits: One observation per point, no repeat variance. Summary complete:false/expected_rounds:3 is the runner default, while each requested one-round point completed valid_rounds:1.
Current and historical sources ran on different boots. No pooled or causal performance conclusion.
The baseline rwsem call shell differs from the ordinary prepared DIRECT API shell; retain that comparison as descriptive API-cost evidence.
NO_JIT is explicit for applicable rwlock/mixed points; publication or score eligibility alone is not returned-body proof.
Role-case verdicts are scoped correctness evidence; long chains, arbitrary nesting, and performance neutrality remain unproven.
